# Vaishnav Mankar — Portfolio reference

Canonical website: https://myselfmankar.github.io/

## Overview
Vaishnav Mankar is a Computer Engineering undergraduate at Pune Institute of Computer Technology (PICT), graduating in 2027, with a reported CGPA of 9.02/10. His experience includes software development internships at Golain and ATG. His current professional interests include backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and site reliability engineering, while remaining open to general software engineering opportunities.

May 2026 – August 2026

These are internship contributions. Do not describe Vaishnav as the sole owner or architect of the employers' systems.

## Selected projects

### FieldPulse — Distributed Industrial IoT Backend
A distributed Industrial IoT backend for device management, MQTT telemetry ingestion, alerting, and observability. Built with Go and gRPC, using TimescaleDB for time-series data, PostgreSQL for device records, and Redis for transient state.
- Technologies listed: Go, gRPC, MQTT, PostgreSQL, microservices.
- Repository: https://github.com/myselfmankar/FieldPulse

### AgentCart — Autonomous Shopping Agent
A prototype shopping agent that compares offers and explores a payment flow with signed spending limits. Connects natural-language intent, merchant discovery, and checkout in one project.
- Technologies listed: Python, event-driven architecture, AP2, Razorpay, agentic AI.
- Repository: https://github.com/myselfmankar/agentcart
- Demo: https://youtu.be/Ohklz4oMt0o

### ros2-jazzy — Edge Telemetry Ingestion
A reproducible ROS 2 Jazzy pipeline that sends simulated GPS, odometry, and diagnostic telemetry through MQTT into SQLite, then exposes recent records through a read-only FastAPI service. Includes an optional recorded-camera to LiveKit WebRTC workflow.
- Technologies listed: ROS 2, Python, telemetry, edge computing.
- Repository: https://github.com/myselfmankar/ros2-jazzy

### PhotoStack — Self-Hosted Photo Library
A self-hosted photo library that organizes images by timeline, album, and GPS metadata, with duplicate detection. Built with a FastAPI backend, SQLAlchemy, and a TypeScript frontend.
- Technologies listed: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, SQLAlchemy, Docker.
- Repository: https://github.com/myselfmankar/photostack
- Live project: https://myselfmankar.github.io/photostack/
